analyst.summary: Tata Communications is a global enterprise-telecom and digital-infrastructure provider within the Tata Group. FY26 profit fell 46% even as revenue grew 7%, the balance sheet carries high leverage (debt/equity around 3.5x) with large contingent liabilities (Rs.18,056 Cr), and our internal system flags this as the highest balance-sheet risk category (RED) in this batch. The headline return on equity looks very high (30-70%+ depending on the period), but this is a function of high debt shrinking the equity base rather than genuine operating excellence. At roughly 48-52 times earnings for a business with declining profit and only 3% five-year revenue growth, we rate this a Sell.
